blurb: Simbelmyne 1.10 is a classical hand-crafted evaluation UCI chess engine written in Rust by Sam Roelants. It combines legal magic-bitboard move generation, modern selectivity (singular, double, triple, and negative extensions, multi-cut, and internal iterative reductions), continuation and correction histories, and a rich incremental classical evaluation. Adapted to UCI over WASI on the poll helper.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build; uses magic bitboards (no x86 PEXT) and 32-bit usize adjustments for embedded LMR tables.

features.label: Magic Bitboards
features.implementation: Legal bitboard move generator using magic bitboards (with optional PEXT on native x86).

features.label: PVS
features.implementation: Negamax PVS with iterative deepening, aspiration windows, check extensions, and improving flag.

features.label: Null Move Pruning
features.implementation: Reduced-depth null-move pruning at non-PV nodes.

features.label: Late Move Reductions
features.implementation: Precomputed LMR table combined with late move pruning, futility pruning, and SEE pruning.

features.label: Reverse Futility Pruning
features.implementation: Static-evaluation beta pruning at shallow non-PV depths.

features.label: Internal Iterative Reductions
features.implementation: Depth reduction when a searched node has no transposition table move.

features.label: Singular & Multi-Extensions
features.implementation: Singular, double, triple, and negative extensions paired with multi-cut pruning.

features.label: Continuation & Correction History
features.implementation: Threat-aware quiet history, 1-/2-/4-ply continuation histories, capture history, and pawn/non-pawn/material correction histories.

features.label: Transposition Table
features.implementation: Hash table caching search bounds, best moves, and static evaluations.

features.label: Pawn Structure Cache
features.implementation: Dedicated pawn-structure cache storing isolated, protected, phalanx, and passed-pawn terms.

features.label: Tapered HCE
features.implementation: Incrementally updated classical evaluation covering PSQTs, outposts, mobility with pins, threats, passed pawns, and endgame scaling.

features.label: King Safety
features.implementation: King-zone attacks, virtual mobility, pawn shield/storm, and safe/unsafe check scoring.
